title: Quick Lazy Ethiopian Rice Pilaf
description: A buttery, cheese‑pull quick‑fix Ethiopian rice pilaf featuring caramel sauce and rendered fat, all made in a lazy‑susan‑spinner for a plant‑based crowd.
instructions: Rinse basmati rice under cold water until water runs clear.
In lazy‑susan‑spinner, heat butter until melted, then stir in caramel sauce and smoked paprika for 1 minute.
Add rinsed rice to the spinner and toast until lightly browned, about 2 minutes.
Pour in vegetable broth, add turmeric, salt, and pepper, then stir to combine.
Cover the spinner and let the rice simmer on low for 10 minutes until liquid is absorbed.
Remove the spinner from heat, fluff rice with a fork, and fold in shredded cheese until melted.
Stir in chopped cilantro, if using, and adjust seasoning.
Serve hot straight from the lazy‑susan‑spinner as a creamy, cheesy Ethiopian rice pilaf.
